Definition: Shaul, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Saul or Shaul = "desired"; 1) a Benjamite, son of Kish, and the 1st king of Israel; 2) an early king of Edom and a successor of Samlah; 3) a son of Simeon; 4) a Levite, son of Uzziah
